events.title: The economy in Imperial Kingdoms
events.summary: Imperial Kingdoms is a real-time with pause, 4X game with a medieval theme. The logistics is an important part of the economy. You have to create buildings on the map and roads to your capital to gather resources. The resources are used in the capital to produce goods and military equipment. There are three estates (serfs, peasants and burghers) with different tasks and production output. New resources and goods can be researched. The four kingdoms will have different military units and bonuses.
